key_classes.role: Permanent validator identity; signs manifests and revocations; node ID is derived from it
key_classes.algorithm_code: Ed25519 or secp256k1 (publicKeyType accepts both; Manifest.cpp)
key_classes.rotation: Never rotated without losing the identity; a new master key is a new validator
key_classes.compromise_outcome: Revocation manifest seq 0xFFFFFFFF (drill E), then new identity

key_classes.role: Signs validations; bound to the master key by the current manifest
key_classes.algorithm_live: secp256k1 compressed (25 of 25 live signing keys)
key_classes.algorithm_code: secp256k1 only, derived from the token's validation secret (ValidatorKeys.cpp)
key_classes.storage_live: Inside the [validator_token] (base64) in postfiatd.cfg, plus the key file
key_classes.rotation: New manifest with sequence + 1, signed by the master key; propagates in minutes
key_classes.compromise_outcome: RECOVERABLE by rotation; stale manifests rejected (drill B)

key_classes.role: Alternative to a token: a 16-byte seed in [validation_seed] generates the validator key
key_classes.algorithm_live: Not observable on the live UNL (all 25 validators publish manifests, i.e. token mode)
key_classes.algorithm_code: secp256k1 from the seed; master = signing = derived key; sequence 0 (ValidatorKeys.cpp)
key_classes.rotation: No rotation path: a new seed is a new identity
key_classes.compromise_outcome: No revocation path without a manifest; the key must be removed from trust by the publisher

key_classes.role: Signs the validator list itself; nodes verify the VL signature against [validator_list_keys]
key_classes.storage_live: Publisher-held; single publisher for the testnet
key_classes.rotation: VL sequence must increase; nodes reject sequence <= current
key_classes.loss_outcome: UNRECOVERABLE for the publisher identity; nodes would need a new publisher key in config
key_classes.compromise_outcome: Attacker can publish a malicious VL until operators change the publisher key

key_classes.role: There is NO separate node key in the pinned code: the node's peer identity is its validation key (nodeID = hash of the master public key)
key_classes.algorithm_live: Same as the validator master key
key_classes.storage_live: Derived at startup; not stored separately

key_classes.role: Transaction signing keys; NOT validator keys, shown only to bound the inventory
key_classes.algorithm_live: Not measured in this pack (no account probes were made)
key_classes.algorithm_code: Ed25519 or secp256k1 (KeyType enum has exactly these two values)
key_classes.loss_outcome: Account-level; out of scope for this pack
key_classes.compromise_outcome: Account-level; out of scope for this pack
